## About me

Hi! I'm Xin (Castor) Yang, an Associate Data Scientist at
[Plymouth Rock Assurance](https://www.plymouthrock.com/), where I build
machine-learning models for insurance claims and deploy them in production.
I received my Ph.D. in Statistics from the
[University of Connecticut](https://uconn.edu/) in 2026, advised by
[Dr. Kun Chen](https://kun-chen.uconn.edu/).
My research develops hidden Markov and mixture models for single-particle data,
in collaboration with chemists studying quantum dots.
I enjoy working where rigorous statistics meets real-world decisions,
and I'm currently exploring causal inference and generative modeling.
